result of multiple bodily trauma to head, upper, and lower body parts resulting

At 1:45 p.m. on June 27, 2016, an employee was acting as a designated safety

At 6:07 p.m. on October 2, 2015, an employee was on the shoulder of an

At 6:30 a.m. on October 5, 2015, an employee was walking along the side of a

At 3:35 p.m. on October 13, 2015, an employee was picking sweet potatoes. The

At 8:00 p.m. on November 16, 2015, an employee was descending a portable wood
